name: Shape morph (compatible paths)
visual_intent: One shape becomes another (blob to blob, wave level to level) for continuity and organic change.
implementation_summary: GSAP core string interpolation of path data; refuses incompatible structures with a clear error. Studio.draw.shape generates morph-ready circles, polygons, stars and rectangles; Studio.draw.morphChain sequences them.

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
